== Summary ==
Source-only comparison for [[General Dodonna (V) (Errata)]] and [[General Dodonna (V) (Errata 3)]]. Left: archived official complete composed region, [[:File:V9-L-generaldodonna-Set9-archive-2021-10-05-composed.png]]. Right: official October 2023 partial, [[:File:V9-L-generaldodonna-Set9-October-2023-partial.png]], using its original mask. The comparison presentation displays each complete region at 745 pixels wide; exact unscaled sources are preserved separately. The published title/badge typography differs; Yoxgit additionally has changed frame treatment and E versus E1 marks. No card pixels were repainted or completed. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
